title: Cleaning-stage configuration
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a state type, and let $x$ be a Boolean input string. Given a natural number $i$, an input-head position among the $|x|+2$ allowed positions, work-tape contents $D_t,D_m$ on the integers, work-tape head positions $D_p$, and a Boolean output string, form a configuration with $2k$ work tapes. Its state is the cleaning state for tape $i$ in the marking phase if $i<k$, and is absent otherwise. In each group of $k$ tapes, tapes with index less than $i$ are blank with head at position zero; the other tapes use the corresponding contents and head positions from $D_t,D_m,D_p$.
hypotheses_covered: An input-head position among the $|x|+2$ allowed positions
Work-tape contents $D_t,D_m$ indexed by tape and integer position
caveat: The payload does not provide the definition of the configuration constructor, so the stated two-group tape layout is inferred from its arguments.
